subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “After a beloved teacher passed away, former students created an online memorial page.”?
options: Together, they showed that memory can live in more than one place.
The doctor showed how sleep affects memory, mood, reaction time, and health.
She did not win first place, but many people remembered her speech.
A powerful idea can make a familiar place feel like a responsibility.

本文沒有陳述「She did not win first place, but many people remembered her speech.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
